text:
[{"word":"intrigue","pronun":"[ɪnˈtriːɡ]","translation":"n. 阴谋；诡计；复杂的事；私通
vt. 用诡计取得；激起...的兴趣
vi. 私通；密谋","audio":"intrigue.mp3"},{"word":"intrinsic","pronun":"[ɪnˈtrɪnzɪkˌɪnˈtrɪnsɪk]","translation":"adj. 本质的，固有的","audio":"intrinsic.mp3"},{"word":"intuition","pronun":"[ˌɪntuˈɪʃn]","translation":"n. 直觉；直觉力；直觉的知识","audio":"intuition.mp3"},{"word":"invalid","pronun":"[ɪnˈvælɪd]","translation":"n. 病人；残疾者
adj. 无效的；有病的；残疾的
vt. 使伤残；使退役
vi. 变得病弱；因病而奉命退役","audio":"invalid.mp3"},{"word":"invaluable","pronun":"[ɪnˈvæljuəbl]","translation":"adj. 无价的；非常贵重的","audio":"invaluable.mp3"},{"word":"invariably","pronun":"[ɪnˈveriəbli]","translation":"adv. 总是；不变地；一定地","audio":"invariably.mp3"},{"word":"inventory","pronun":"[ˈɪnvəntɔːri]","translation":"n. 存货，存货清单；详细目录；财产清册","audio":"inventory.mp3"},{"word":"invert","pronun":"[ɪnˈvɜːrt]","translation":"n. 颠倒的事物；倒置物；倒悬者
adj. 转化的
vt. 使…转化；使…颠倒；使…反转；使…前后倒置","audio":"invert.mp3"},{"word":"invest","pronun":"[ɪnˈvest]","translation":"vi. 投资，入股；花钱买
vt. 投资；覆盖；耗费；授予；包围","audio":"invest.mp3"},{"word":"investigate","pronun":"[ɪnˈvestɪɡeɪt]","translation":"v. 调查；研究","audio":"investigate.mp3"},{"word":"invisible","pronun":"[ɪnˈvɪzəbl]","translation":"adj. 无形的，看不见的；无形的；不显眼的，暗藏的","audio":"invisible.mp3"},{"word":"involve","pronun":"[ɪnˈvɑːlv]","translation":"vt. 包含；牵涉；使陷于；潜心于","audio":"involve.mp3"},{"word":"involvement","pronun":"[ɪnˈvɑːlvmənt]","translation":"n. 牵连；包含；混乱；财政困难","audio":"involvement.mp3"},{"word":"irony","pronun":"[ˈaɪrəni]","translation":"n. 讽刺；反语；具有讽刺意味的事
adj. 铁的；似铁的","audio":"irony.mp3"},{"word":"irrespective","pronun":"[ˌɪrɪˈspektɪv]","translation":"adj. 无关的；不考虑的；不顾的","audio":"irrespective.mp3"},{"word":"irrigation","pronun":"[ˌɪrɪˈɡeɪʃn]","translation":"n. 灌溉；[临床] 冲洗；冲洗法","audio":"irrigation.mp3"},{"word":"irritate","pronun":"[ˈɪrɪteɪt]","translation":"vt. 刺激，使兴奋；激怒
vi. 引起恼怒，引起不愉快","audio":"irritate.mp3"},{"word":"isle","pronun":"[aɪl]","translation":"n. 岛
vt. 使成为岛屿
vi. 住在岛屿上","audio":"isle.mp3"},{"word":"isolate","pronun":"[ˈaɪsəleɪt]","translation":"n. [生物] 隔离种群
vt. 使隔离；使孤立；使绝缘
adj. 隔离的；孤立的
vi. 隔离；孤立","audio":"isolate.mp3"},{"word":"issue","pronun":"[ˈɪʃuː]","translation":"n. 问题；流出；期号；发行物
vt. 发行，发布；发给；放出，排出
vi. 发行；流出；造成…结果；传下","audio":"issue.mp3"}]
